newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TEN CATE SEES IMPROVED 1997 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: TEN CATE SEES IMPROVED 1997 RESULTS.

text.p: Textiles and plastics processor Koninklijke Ten Cate NV said on Friday it expected a further increase in results in 1997.
"Barring unforeseen circumstances, Koninklijke Ten Cate expects a further increase in results to be possible in 1997," it said.

The company earlier posted a 1996 net profit from normal operations of 32.1 million guilders, compared with 26.8 million in 1995. Last August, Ten Cate said it expected improvements to continue in the second half of 1996, after first-half profits had surged by 60 percent.
